localFacts.fact: Tameside publishes its term dates for Tameside MBC community schools on its Pupil Days (Holidays and Term Times) page.
Tameside has used different summer half term and end of year dates for primary and secondary schools, with primary schools taking a longer Whitsun break and finishing a week later.
Mossley primary schools, where most pupils take part in processions, must take Whit Friday as a pupil closure day if it falls during term time.
Parents of secondary pupils who want their child to take part in the Whit Friday processions should obtain the consent of the governing body.
Individual schools advise if they will close on election dates; general elections are usually treated as an unavoidable closure because of the late notice.
